conversation_starters.title: Highway 280 reopens in time for Minnesota State Fair
conversation_starters.summary: Highway 280 has reopened after a four-month closure. The short connector along the Minneapolis–St. Paul border was shut from I-94, the interstate through the center of the metro, to Highway 36/I-35 just to the north.

Is getting around any easier now that it's open again?
conversation_starters.description: Highway 280 has finally reopened after being closed for the last four months. The road was closed from 1-94 to Highway 36/1-35.

you_should_know.description: Minneapolis leaders are trying to figure out what role data centers play in the city's future. Mayor Jacob Frey says he wants to harness the economic benefit without the environmental cost.

you_should_know.title: Does a copper-nickel mine near Minnesota's Boundary Waters make sense?
you_should_know.summary: Advocates say a copper-nickel mine near the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, lake country on the Canadian border roughly 250 miles north of Minneapolis, is the type of diversification needed to keep the industry alive in the region. Concerned neighbors worry that it could compromise the watershed and tarnish the wilderness area. Beyond environmental concerns, some wonder if a copper-nickel mine in the area makes sense.
